name: forgejo
author: mika@phyroks.de
description:
Forgejo is a self-hosted lightweight software forge.
Easy to install and low maintenance, it just does the job.

installation.script:
## forgejo Installscript

## update system
apt update
apt -y install --no-install-recommends jq curl ca-certificates

## Variables
ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && echo "amd64" || echo "arm64")
LATEST=$(curl -X 'GET' https://data.forgejo.org/api/v1/repos/forgejo/forgejo/releases/latest | jq .name -r | cut -c 2-)


cd /mnt/server

## install forgejo
echo -e "Download url:https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/forgejo/releases/download/v${LATEST}/forgejo-${LATEST}-linux-${ARCH}"
if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo -e "downloading Forgejo $LATEST"
    curl -sSL -o forgejo  https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/forgejo/releases/download/v${LATEST}/forgejo-${LATEST}-linux-${ARCH}
else
    curl -sSL -o forgejo  https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/forgejo/releases/download/v${LATEST}/forgejo-${LATEST}-linux-${ARCH}
    echo -e "downloading Forgejo $VERSION"
fi

chmod +x forgejo

mkdir -p custom

if [ -f "/mnt/server/custom/app.ini" ]; then
    echo "config file exists"
else
    echo "[server]
    LOCAL_ROOT_URL = http://${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}/
    DOMAIN           = ${SERVER_IP}
    HTTP_PORT        = ${SERVER_PORT}
    ROOT_URL         = http://${SERVER_IP}:${SERVER_PORT}/
    DISABLE_SSH      = ${DISABLE_SSH}
    SSH_PORT         = ${SSH_PORT}" > /mnt/server/custom/app.ini
fi

echo -e "-------------------------------------------------"
echo -e "Installation completed"
echo -e "-------------------------------------------------"
